headline: Full premium audit executed 15/15 — /proof and the Atlas constellation shipped, /status stopped lying about an incident, and the sitewide theme boot that never worked is fixed at the generator.

items.title: Sitewide theme boot fixed — it had never worked
items.insight: classList.remove.apply(element, r) ran with the wrong `this` and a try/catch ate the TypeError on every page since multi-theme shipped; a post-paint repair script masked it as a theme flash. The CANON-047 image-test harness caught it on first run — screenshot review finds what green gates cannot.

items.title: /proof — visitors re-verify the deploy ledger in their own browser
items.insight: The evidence apparatus was the site's most under-exploited asset. WebCrypto re-computation of digest, content addresses, chain links, chronology, and head/depth — plus an agents.json action with the same recipe — turns 'trust us' into 'check for yourself' for humans and machines alike.

items.title: A challenged vantage can no longer publish a false public incident
items.insight: A CF interstitial rendered as mismatch 0/5 on /status while the routes were healthy (live re-probe: 5/5). Challenge classification is now one shared primitive with unverified checked before mismatch — D-S300.1 applied to the surface it had missed, reusable by every sibling prober.

items.title: Atlas constellation — the book of maps got an actual map
items.insight: Server-rendered deterministic SVG (FNV-1a layout) delivers a signature visual moment with zero client JS and zero CLS — immersion does not have to cost performance budget.

items.title: Three instruments stopped overstating: context-meter, geo-vitals, link failures
items.insight: The meter's consumers now accept exit-by-verdict (UNMEASURED is a reading, not a failure); geo-vitals binds freshness to its input corpus, not its regeneration clock; identity link failures write privacy-safe receipts with recovery copy instead of a generic dead end.
